serialization_contract.options_use: Submit id unchanged, preserving JSON string/number/boolean types; label is presentation only.
serialization_contract.condition_paths: Absolute root paths; [] means the same containing repeater item in active_when.
serialization_contract.default_semantics: A documented default describes server omission behavior, not permission to send every default. Missing default means unavailable, not null.
serialization_contract.constraint_semantics: Missing limit, range, step, required flag or default means it is not stated in the local source. Do not invent a service constraint from the widget; the service remains authoritative.
serialization_contract.language_options: options_complete=false means load runtime options or permit explicit code entry. Do not restrict to the local eleven-language subset.
serialization_contract.slider_steps: Where step is not documented, allow decimals (HTML step=any).
serialization_contract.arrays: multi-select/chips use arrays; repeaters use their item schema; labels is a direct string-valued object.
serialization_contract.object_controls: Recursively render fields/items; no documented composite requires a raw JSON editor.
serialization_contract.labels_origin: Top-level labels/groups are editorial; vocabulary labels are copied from the source.
